translations.language.title: Language settings
translations.language.description: Install language packs to change Brightdesk’s menus and tools. Choose a separate proofing language for spelling in your documents.

translations.language.proofingDescription: Sets the language used for spelling checks while you write. This setting is separate from the display language.
translations.language.importHelp: You can also install a Brightdesk .bdlang language-pack file from your computer.
translations.language.restartNotNeeded: No restart needed. The display language changes straight away.
translations.language.proofingNative: macOS uses the spelling languages configured in macOS settings.
translations.language.proofingSupported: The selected spelling dictionary is supported by this Brightdesk build.
translations.language.proofingUnavailable: This language pack is installed, but a matching spelling dictionary is not available in this build. The editor language tag will still be set.
translations.language.importFailed: Could not import that language pack.
